rubriker.title: ChessBase´26 – Tips for Beginners, part 31: Endgame expert with the "LiveBook"
rubriker._rss_content: How do you train endgames? To be honest, the question might be better phrased as: Do you even train endgames at all? After all, the magical richness of the final phase of a game is something not everyone appreciates. This makes it all the more important that training is enjoyable and not bogged down by unnecessarily long searches for the right solution. In this regard, the LiveBook feature of ChessBase´26 may not be familiar to everyone. All the more reason, then, to introduce this highly practical tool in this tutorial.

rubriker.title: Salesforce to power the future of chess
rubriker._rss_content: It is the biggest contract in FIDE's history with a private entity: Salesforce is becoming the title sponsor and technological partner of the International Chess Federation. The partnership brings the Agentforce 360 portfolio, including Slack, to the world’s largest chess events and forums, powering real-time player rankings and AI-driven fan experiences for over 800 million global fans. Press release.
